period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported); comparator column is 31.12.2019. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2020 (9-month, Jan-Sep). SOLO basis, matching the main Q4/annual series. Starting with the half-year/quarter ended 30 June 2015, this bank's interim filings began including a genuine second 'Balance Sheet'/'Profit and Loss Account' section (without the word 'Consolidated' in the heading) in addition to the Consolidated statements that appear earlier in the same document -- this Solo section is used here. Confirmed genuinely Solo (not a mislabeled repeat of the Consolidated figures) because: (a) its own figures are consistently smaller than the Consolidated section earlier in the same document, and (b) its prior-year-end comparator column reproduces this dataset's own independently-sourced annual Q4 Solo figure for that date exactly or to within rounding. From FY2021 onward the bank's own filings explicitly label this section 'Balance Sheet-Solo Basis' / 'Profit and Loss Account-Solo Basis' on their face. Comparator Total Assets (220,478,418,636) matches FY2019 Q4 Solo exactly. Q2/H1 2020 could not be found on the bank's live site, its CMS listing, or Wayback Machine -- treated as a genuine, permanent gap for this one quarter (likely a genuine COVID-19-era filing/publication gap, consistent with the sector-wide disruption documented for FY2020 elsewhere in this dataset). EPS field not legible and not estimated.
